# coldcallx.app

Static marketing site for Cold Call X. Deployed to GitHub Pages on every push to
`main` (`.github/workflows/static.yml`); `CNAME` points the Pages site at
`coldcallx.app`.

## privacy.html is generated — do not edit it directly

```bash
node scripts/generate-privacy.mjs           # rebuild privacy.html
node scripts/generate-privacy.mjs --check   # CI: fail if stale
```

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `content/privacy.md` | The policy text. A verbatim copy of `docs/APP_PRIVACY.md` in the app repo. |
| `templates/privacy.template.html` | Page shell: head, SEO/OG tags, styling, header and footer. |
| `privacy.html` | **Generated output. Edits here are overwritten and fail CI.** |

The deploy workflow runs `--check`, so a hand-edit to `privacy.html` blocks the
deploy instead of silently shipping.

### Why

`privacy.html` was hand-maintained and drifted about thirteen months behind the
app. It kept asserting things that had stopped being true — "does not send any
personal data to external servers", "all information stays on your device" —
after the app gained a paid subscription, a Sign in with Apple account, and a
Telnyx-backed calling service that necessarily processes call destinations.
Generating the page makes that class of drift a build failure rather than a
thing nobody notices.

### Keeping the policy in sync

`--check` only proves `privacy.html` matches `content/privacy.md`. It **cannot**
tell that `content/privacy.md` is behind the app repo — these are separate
repositories. When `docs/APP_PRIVACY.md` changes in the app repo:

```bash
cp ../../Ccx/coldcallerx/docs/APP_PRIVACY.md content/privacy.md
node scripts/generate-privacy.mjs
```

Then commit both files together.

The canonical policy has three other renderings, all fed by the same Markdown:

- the in-app modal (`src/components/PrivacyPolicyModal.tsx`), pinned by
  `privacyPolicyParity.test.ts`;
- the Cloudflare Worker's `/privacy` page, generated by
  `telnyx-api-worker/scripts/generate-privacy-policy.mjs`; **this is the URL
  registered in App Store Connect**, not this site;
- this page.
